intro1: Ely’s period houses near the cathedral and its open-plan new homes need very different furniture, and we make both to measure.
intro2: We design and make every kitchen, wardrobe and bedroom around your measurements, keeping period detail where it matters and giving you a modern finish where you want one. Ely is about 30 miles from our Peterborough workshop, comfortably inside our 80-mile area.
sty: Full-height wardrobes for a tall period room, one scheme for an open-plan kitchen or a home office for commuting days: each piece is made for its room.
proc_lead: Making takes four to six weeks once you approve the design. Ely is 45 to 50 minutes away, so we plan full fitting days on site without rushing.
steps: We measure the room and note original features, ceiling heights and how the space is used. Free, with no obligation.
In open-plan homes we design the kitchen, utility and media wall together in 3D, with a quote that lists every item.
Every piece is built to your measurements in our Brassey Close workshop.
We schedule full days in Ely so the job is done properly, by the people who made it.
bk: Send us photos on WhatsApp or book a visit. We’ll come to your Ely home, measure up and send you a 3D design with an itemised quote. It’s free and there’s no obligation.
det: Our showroom and workshop are in Peterborough, around 30 miles from Ely. As well as Ely itself, we design and fit in Littleport, Soham, Witchford and Sutton. We cover homes up to 80 miles from Peterborough, so if you’re further out, call 01733 686767 and we’ll tell you straight away.
faqs: Do you travel to Ely for design visits and fitting?
Yes. Ely is about 30 miles from our workshop, usually 45 to 50 minutes depending on the route, and we also cover Littleport, Soham, Witchford and Sutton.
My home is listed or in the conservation area. Can I still have fitted furniture?

Usually, yes. Internal fitted furniture is normally straightforward, but changes that affect original fabric may need consent. We’ll raise anything like that at the survey so you can check with East Cambridgeshire District Council.
Can you fit a home office into a spare bedroom?
Yes. With many Ely households commuting to Cambridge or working from home part of the week, fitted desks and home offices are among the things we’re asked for most.
What does a fitted kitchen cost?
Straightforward fitted kitchens start from around £5,000. Larger kitchens with premium worktops and appliances cost more. Your itemised quote after the free survey shows the full breakdown.
